description: This file defines a frontend component for rendering a note item in a list, utilizing LightningJS for UI components. It manages presentation and interactions for individual notes, including visual states and auxiliary functions like time formatting.

classes.name: NoteListItem
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing a single note item in a list, displaying thumbnail, title, preview, and timestamp, with visual states based on selection.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Invokes the store to select the current note, is called when the component is entered (clicked).
